name: Chlormezanone

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1996 — for serious skin reactions

summary: Chlormezanone was removed from the market worldwide starting in 1996 because it caused skin-related harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests done on people, gave this drug low scores for liver effects and heart effects [M]. These computer-predicted risk scores were 49 for the liver and 48 for the heart [M].
